Global multipliers on top of all the other data. study_power scales every study reward. Tuned 1 Nov: no study = dies in round 1-2; quiz every 5-10s = several rounds. 1 Nov: enemy_damage 0.1 -> 0.2 because Flash now moves and dodges.

Flash scores 16 directions every decide_every seconds and takes the safest. preferred_range is a fraction of his longest weapon range (melee builds move in, ranged builds hang back). fear = how much he avoids skeletons; trap_fear = how much he avoids being boxed in.

Keeps rounds tense. Raises intensity (more, tougher, harder-hitting skeletons) while Flash is comfortable; backs off (never below 1 = normal) when he's struggling. The cap grows each round. Below danger_hp the game shows 'answer a quiz to heal him'. Last final_surge_seconds of a round spawn faster.

Word gems: up to max_pairs Thai/English pairs drift in the arena (a new pair every spawn_every s, each lives life s, drifting at speed). Pop quiz: over the lesson after about pop_quiz_every_words words read and at least pop_quiz_min_seconds apart; each one closed without answering doubles the wait, up to pop_quiz_max_backoff times. Rescue: when Flash is in danger a question appears in the game column (another after a right answer, up to rescue_chain), at most every rescue_cooldown s. slow_motion = game speed while a question is open. Decoys: gems with no partner, decoys_min at the start of a run and one more every decoys_every_matches pairs matched, up to decoys_max (a new one at most every decoy_every s). Timers: a pop quiz gives pop_timer_new s for a word never answered right, x pop_timer_shrink for each right answer in a row since its last mistake, never under pop_timer_min s. rescue_time = the Save Flash! countdown.

Learning mode, offered on the 'Flash fell!' screen. Words: the ones missed (a gem pair drifted away, a question timed out) or got wrong this run, worst first, up to max_words; topped up to min_words with other words from the run. Each is shown as a joined Thai = English pair reps times (reps_hard for words that went wrong twice or more), Thai first then English first; each stays show_seconds unless the learner taps on. Then a test: test_pairs pairs at a time, no decoys; a word is right if matched with no wrong try starting from it. A score of pass (0.8 = 80%) or more wins one random item of bonus_rarities, given at the start of the next run (up to max_bonus can wait). The arena stays calm: one skeleton every skeleton_every s, never more than skeleton_max, Flash can't be hurt, no XP or gold.

Learn mode (chosen on the start screen; Test is the game as it was). A word's Thai gem shows its English, and the pair shares a colour, until the word has been matched learn_hint_until times without help (or the course already counts it as known); 👁 Show answers shows it on every word. A match made with the answer showing gives learn_helped_strength of the power. A wrong pair lights up the right partner. Decoys: learn_decoys_min to learn_decoys_max, only from words already met. At most learn_new_per_round never-seen words per round. Skeletons hit for learn_enemy_damage of normal. In the course: gems and pop quizzes lean hard on the words just read, and ⏩ Auto-move (reading mode) moves the slide on by itself. Word ladder (Learn mode): learn_pairs pairs stay on screen, from the whole lesson; a popped pair is replaced at once. A word shows its answer until it has been matched learn_shows times; then it is tested (no answer). Right = it stays tested (learned_after right in a row = ⭐ learned, comes up less); wrong = back to learning for learn_relearn_shows more. learn_new_per_round 0 = no limit on new words. Learn mode is not balanced: Flash's health never goes below learn_hp_floor, skeletons come at learn_spawn_rate. A word due for testing comes back as a warned ✍ mini test after learn_test_after other matches, with learn_test_choices English answers. (3 Nov) Learn mode is the normal game with the answers showing: learn_enemy_damage 1, learn_hp_floor 0, learn_spawn_rate 1, learn_helped_strength 1 = no difference from Test; change them only to make Learn mode gentler on purpose.

The word card (the default; Options > Words can switch back to the classic gem hunt). Each word climbs, separately for Thai -> meaning, meaning -> Thai and listening: meet (one answer, meet_reps times) -> pick of 2 (pick2_right right) -> pick of 4 (pick4_right right) -> recall (no choices, self-graded). Meaning -> Thai starts at pick of 4 of Thai -> meaning; listening at recall (words with a recording). In a session a word comes back after gaps[n] other questions (wrong_gap after a wrong answer); at most max_new words in their first steps (max_new_good above high_acc right, none below low_acc); a right answer slower than slow_ms doesn't move it up. Between sessions: box_days. Learned = recalled twice at least learned_gap_h hours apart; long-term = box longterm_box (passed the 7-day review). Next level offered at ready_share of the level recognised. A right answer powers Flash like a matched pair (meet_strength for a meeting, recall_strength for a recall); the next card comes next_after_* seconds later.
